dict.string: pi-os reads the window you pin with its hotkey to answer your question.

pi-os listens only while you hold the pi-os hotkey. Your speech is transcribed on this Mac and the text is used like a typed request. Audio is kept only if you turn on “Keep my last voice takes” in Settings, and then only on this Mac.
pi-os uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to turn what you say while holding the pi-os hotkey into a request. Audio does not leave this Mac.
